episodes.synopsis: Takuya, a young boy dealing with the death of his father, gets a bizarre letter in the mail. It leads him to the local cliffs, where strange things are happening, and he meets a mysterious girl...
episodes.title: You Know?

episodes.synopsis: Takuya tries to find out what powers his new device has, as well as what its limitations might be. He gets the perfect chance to test it when his mother is attacked...
episodes.title: Parallel World Constitutive Theorem

episodes.synopsis: Ayumi holds a meeting with the townspeople to discuss the deaths from the lightning strikes. She’s beginning to crack under the pressure of running her job site.
episodes.title: Tears That Can't Be Stopped

episodes.synopsis: Ayumi is acting strange the day after the meeting with the townspeople. Takuya begins to suspect that something is very wrong.
episodes.title: Dirtied White Skin

episodes.synopsis: The time has come to put the Reflector Device to use. But Takuya will find that it’s harder than he thinks.
episodes.title: Spiral of Tragedy

episodes.synopsis: With Ayumi safe, it’s up to Takuya to prove her innocence. He breaks into Geotech with Kaori to get the info he needs.
episodes.title: Beyond a Pale Light

episodes.synopsis: Takuya goes to deliver his father’s research notes to Ryuzoji’s house, where he realizes that something is very wrong.
episodes.title: The Cause of the Curse

episodes.synopsis: Mio is depressed after finding out about her father's corrupt activities. Even worse, he's sending her out of the country…
episodes.title: The Sparrows and Swallows Know Not

episodes.synopsis: After Mio's father is revealed to be corrupt, her reputation at school is ruined. Before she leaves Japan forever, there's one last thing she wants to do.
episodes.title: The Distance Between Him and Her

episodes.synopsis: Takuya chases Mio into the strange tower that forms Mt. Sankaku. But there's more inside than he knew…
episodes.title: Feelings Overlapping

episodes.synopsis: Takuya and Mio are trapped beneath Mt. Sankaku, with Mitsuki hunting them. And at dawn, the lightning will begin to strike…
episodes.title: That Kiss, Once More

episodes.synopsis: Having saved Mio, Takuya finds himself back where he started. What awaits him this time?
episodes.title: The Secret Under the White Coat

episodes.synopsis: Takuya works with Eriko to discover Ryuzoji's secrets. He learns that her past is far different than what he ever suspected…
episodes.title: An Ordained Fate

episodes.synopsis: Takuya begins a new time loop. This time, his target is Kanna, who seems to know far more than a transfer student should…
episodes.title: The Transfer Student's Friend

episodes.synopsis: Takuya and his friends head to Mio's private beach to enjoy a fun summer vacation. But suddenly the Reflector Device goes missing…
episodes.title: A Summer That Won't Come Back

episodes.synopsis: Kanna is being threatened by Hojo, a private detective working for Ryuzoji. She says goodbye to Takuya, and threatens to leave forever…
episodes.title: Within Unmoving Time

episodes.synopsis: Posters have gone up on the school bullitin board denouncing Kanna, and she's going to transfer away from the school. Before she goes, Takuya goes to meet with her one last time…
episodes.title: A Pale, Ephemeral Vow

episodes.synopsis: Takuya finds himself in the mysterious world of Dela Granto. Alone and far from home, he searches for the psychite to save Kanna.
episodes.title: Twilight in Dela Granto

episodes.synopsis: Takuya and Sayless give birth to a beautiful daughter, Yu-No. But all is not well in his new world
episodes.title: The Bond Between Parent and Child

episodes.synopsis: Sayless is killed by guards from the imperial city, and Takuya sets out into the deadly Rafaelo desert to get revenge.
episodes.title: Into the Rafaelo Desert

episodes.synopsis: Takuya is imprisoned in the quarry and forced to mine "holy stones", which appear to be the psychite he seeks. A year passes as he attempts to escape…
episodes.title: The Quarry Where Demons Rule

episodes.synopsis: Takuya and the resistance try to find a way to escape from their prison, while the day of the ritual draws near.
episodes.title: Escape from the Quarry

episodes.synopsis: The resistance begins its assault on the Divine Emperor's castle, and Takuya reunites with someone he didn't expect to see.
episodes.title: The Imperial City, Where the Wind Blows

episodes.synopsis: Takuya discovers the truth behind the other world of Dela Granto, and the coming disaster.
episodes.title: The Truth of Dela Granto

episodes.synopsis: The ritual to save both worlds is held, but is interrupted at the last second by Ryuzoji, who plans to interrupt it so that everything dies.
episodes.title: The Promised Ritual

episodes.synopsis: The ritual is completed, but Yu-No must pay a heavy price. Will Takuya be there for her?
episodes.title: A Girl Who Chants Love at the Bound of This World
